title: Scalar-compatible augmented Cech sheaf construction without exactness
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], I an index type in its universe, U:I -> Opens(X) any family of opens, and F an O_X-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Put A=Gamma(X,O_X) and C=cechComplexFunctor(U)(W -> (B -> F(W product B))) [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], with the A-action restricted from X. There exist a nonnegative cochain complex D of O_X-module sheaves, an augmentation epsilon:F[0] -> D, and natural A-module-presheaf isomorphisms e_p:forget(D^p) -> C^p. For each p, forget(d_D^p) e_(p+1) = e_p d_C^p. On each open B and singleton tuple y:Fin(1) -> I, the y-coordinate of e_0 epsilon^0 is restriction along prod.snd:(product_l U_(y(l))) product B -> B. For each p, D^p is isomorphic as a module sheaf to the product over y:Fin(p+1) -> I of j_y,*(F restricted to inf_l U_(y(l))). For each p,y,B let c be the y-coordinate of e_p(B). For every a in O_X(B) and s in D^p(B), c(a s) = (restriction of a along prod.snd) c(s). No covering or quasi-isomorphism assertion is made. The empty index type, empty scheme, zero module, and infinite families are included.

proof.text: Use the actual intersection sheaf functor, complex D = cechModuleSheafComplex U F, and degree-zero restriction a = cechModuleSheafAugmentation₀ U F of [def-pc-cech-module-sheaf-functor]. The proved cechModuleSheafAugmentation₀_comp_d gives a followed by the first differential equal to zero. These are explicit constructions, not objects chosen from an unproved existence statement.

Construct the canonical comparisons privately, as in CechModuleSheafComparison, retaining their explicit projection equation. Write G for the forgetful functor to presheaves of global modules. On B, G(P(W)) restricts scalars first from global functions to B and then along prod.snd to W product B. ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'App identifies this with direct scalar restriction to W product B. The two ring maps coincide by functoriality and thinness of opens. Its underlying map is the identity, so it is natural in B and W. Evaluation of G is evaluation of module sheaves followed by restriction of scalars, both preserving products. Thus asIso(piComparison G) followed by Pi.mapIso of these scalar identifications defines e_p. The private intersectionProductComparison_hom_π proves the projection identity for arbitrary families of opens using piComparison_comp_π and Pi.mapIso_hom_π; specializing it to the Cech family identifies its y-coordinate with G of the module-sheaf product projection followed by the scalar identification.

The product comparisons are natural on opposite formal coproducts: project each side to y and use piComparison_comp_π, Pi.lift_π and functoriality of G. Whisker this natural isomorphism by the formal Cech object and compose with the functorial scalar comparison. The private cechModuleSheafDegreeIso_naturality proves compatibility with every simplex morphism between arbitrary degrees (also codegeneracies); specialization to each simplex coface gives coface compatibility; its degree components are exactly the e_p constructed above. Expand both differentials by CochainComplex.of_d and AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD. Additivity of G, map_sum and map_zsmul transfer the finite alternating sums, proving the differential identity. Project G(a) followed by e_0 to y; the projection equation and Pi.lift_π reduce it to the over-site adjunction unit, whose section map is F.map prod.snd.op.

Extend a to epsilon using CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv and a followed by d equal to zero. fromSingle₀Equiv_symm_apply_f_zero and the singleObjXSelf inverse equation give singleObjXSelf.inv followed by epsilon.f 0 = a. Substitution transfers the preceding augmentation coordinate equation to epsilon.

Apply cechModuleSheafComplex_term_iso of [lem-pc-cech-module-sheaf-terms] in every degree for the product of open direct images. For the last clause, evaluate the canonical projection equation on a section t: the y-coordinate of e_p(t) is the module-sheaf product projection evaluated on B. That projection is O_X(B)-linear by the definition of a module-sheaf morphism, so map_smul gives its value on a times s. The action on the intersection sheaf is definitionally restriction along prod.snd, and the scalar identification has identity underlying map. Substituting the coordinate identities for a times s and s gives the required formula. Package D, epsilon, e, differential compatibility, augmentation coordinates, term isomorphisms and local scalar compatibility. Empty index types are handled by the same categorical products and vacuous coordinate formulas; no cover, affine or finite-index hypothesis is used.

theorem exists_augmented_linear_cech_sheaf_complex
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (F : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (D : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ)
      (ε : (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).obj F ⟶ D)
      (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat)).X p),
      (∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1)) ∧
      (∀ (y : Fin 1 → ι) (V : X.Opens),
        ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 F).inv ≫ ε.f 0).val ≫
          (e 0).hom ≫
            Pi.π (fun y : Fin 1 → ι =>
              ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
                (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat).obj
                  (op (∏ᶜ fun l => U (y l)))) y).app (op V) =
          F.presheafModuleCat.map (prod.snd : (∏ᶜ fun l => U (y l)) ⨯ V ⟶ V).op) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, Nonempty (D.X p ≅ ∏ᶜ fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ι =>
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (⨅ l, U (y l)).ι).obj (F.restrict (⨅ l, U (y l)).ι))) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ι) (B : X.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(F, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ U (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ι ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ U (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X, B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ U (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s)
